m02_lut25_1.description: D'=25 gives 1 instead of 0 (near-tie 0.4923 rounded up)

m04_lut20_1.description: entry D'=20 off by one: 2 -> 1 (equal-neighbour region)

m06_lut0_254.description: entry D'=0: 255 -> 254 (W[0] bit stuck 0 at the peak)

m07_truncate.description: no rounding: D' = D >> s (rounding bit ignored)

m08_tie_down.description: ties round down: D' = (D + 2^(s-1) - 1) >> s (round-half-down, full-width reformulation)

m09_tie_even.description: ties round to even (banker's rounding of D/2^s; full-width reformulation)

m10_shift8_decode.description: shift = 8 decoded as shift = 0 (stage-8 select boundary off by one)

m11_shift0_oor.description: shift = 0: D = 32..63 not flagged out of range (last stage check skipped at s=0)

m13_carry_lost.description: rounding carry to D'=32 not flagged (index[5] dropped): e.g. s=1, D=63 gives 255

m14_bit21_ignored.description: D[21] ignored (D >= 2^21 aliases to D - 2^21); unreachable with a consistent tape

m16_default_1.description: table default D'=25..31 gives 1 (saturation region nonzero)

m17_default_x.description: table default D'=25..31 gives X (unspecified; 2-state sims may read 0)

m18_stage_check.description: stage-4 discarded-bit check dropped: shift without bit 2 and D bits lost from stage8[12:9]

m19_rare_point.description: one rare point: D = 1337, shift = 7 (D'=10) gives 22 instead of 21 (1 of 2^26 inputs)

m20_rare_highD.description: one rare point above the consistent-tape range: D = 22'h3FFFFF, shift = 15 gives 255

m21_r1_latency2.description: REGISTERED=1: two-cycle latency (extra W and done stage)

m22_r1_comb_bypass.description: REGISTERED=1: W shows the new weight combinationally in the start cycle (latency 0)

m23_r1_load_always.description: REGISTERED=1: W reloads every cycle (no hold while start = 0)

m24_r1_W_noreset.description: REGISTERED=1: W not cleared by reset (done still is)

m25_r1_start_over_reset.description: REGISTERED=1: start has priority over reset for W

m26_r1_done_stretch.description: REGISTERED=1: done stays high one extra cycle

m27_r1_async_reset.description: REGISTERED=1: asynchronous reset (clears W/done when rst_n falls, before the edge)

m29_r1_initval.description: REGISTERED=1: initial values on W_r/done_r (no ASIC power-up value)

m30_r0_rst_gates_W.description: REGISTERED=0: W forced to 0 while rst_n = 0 (never observed in the chip)

m32_r0_registered_W.description: REGISTERED=0: W registered (one-cycle latency in the chip configuration)

m33_r0_latch.description: REGISTERED=0: W through a transparent-high latch on clk

m34_default_param0.description: interface: default REGISTERED changed 1 -> 0 (test/blocks instantiates the default)

m35_r0_rare_point.description: REGISTERED=0 only: one interior point D = 1337, shift = 7 (D'=10) gives 22 instead of 21; R1 correct

m36_r0_entry_one_shift.description: REGISTERED=0 only: entry D'=6 wrong (57 -> 56) at shift 11 only (2,048 D values)

m37_r0_mid_interval.description: REGISTERED=0 only: W off by one for D in [3000, 3010] at shift 10 (inside the D'=3 interval, away from every boundary)

m38_r0_rare_x.description: REGISTERED=0 only: W = X at one interior point (D = 1337, shift = 7); probes the X check off the edge set

m39_rare_x_both.description: weight = X at one interior point (D = 1337, shift = 7), both configurations

e02_fullwidth_round.description: full-width reformulation: D' = (D + 2^(s-1)) >> s at 23 bits, W = D' < 25 ? table : 0

e04_r1_mux_hold.description: REGISTERED=1: if (start) W_r <= weight written as W_r <= start ? weight : W_r

e05_explicit_zeros.description: explicit zero entries D'=25..31 added before the default
